concept_options.title: What If Nobody Could Say No to You?
concept_options.hook: You ask the ticket checker to let you off the fine, as a joke. He tears it up and thanks you.
concept_options.visual_approach: night metro gate: you large at the left, hand out palm up; the boss, the ticket checker and your mother (bun and shawl) in a row at the right with the same fixed smile; one crimson arrow at your mother's smile. Three thumbnail candidates a, b, c differ in the tag (MEANT IT?, EVEN HER?, ALL OF THEM?)
concept_options.why_this_works: The topic title from the 2026-11-10 slate (f-nobody-says-no, 78/100); the writer's pick

selected_concept.rationale: Owner's pick at G1 (2026-11-11): title A, "What If Nobody Could Say No to You?", with thumbnail b ("EVEN HER?").

stages.approach: Packaging: three titles, three one-variable thumbnails drawn from the rig, the beat outline; the G1 room (viewer, story editor, claims check)
research.md, claims.md and script.md under rules/story.md; the free local Qwen-Arthur narration and a 720p first cut before G2; the G2 room; omni qc story_script must pass
Picture lock: cut, key shot, text, music and mix; the paid Arthur take only after the owner's A/B by ear
The owner watches at 1x with cold viewers
publish.md and upload.yaml; private upload only when the owner asks

line_items.notes: Not estimated. Paid, only after G2 and the owner's A/B at G3; quoted and approved first. G1 made no paid call: the thumbnails are drawn in code
